function: Massive MIMO uplink symbol detection: a deep eigen network gives MMSE-like initial symbol estimates that seed a probabilistic Tabu search (p. 1).
system: Uplink massive MIMO, Nr=16 or 24 receive antennas, Nt=16 or 24 single-antenna users, flat Rayleigh, 4/16-QAM; no RIS; frequency band not stated (p. 3, p. 9).
method: DeepEigNet: eigen-based RNN plus L-layer sparsely connected refinement network, supervised offline training with Adam; followed by non-learned probabilistic Tabu search (p. 4-6, p. 10).
data_channel: Simulated flat Rayleigh channels, entries CN(0,1); 100 channel realizations with 100 symbols per antenna; SNR drawn uniformly over the range; no public dataset (p. 3, p. 9-10).
test_conditions: Same flat Rayleigh model in training and test (50/50 split); one weight set for all SNRs; imperfect-CSI test, error variance 0.01 to 0.1 (p. 10, p. 14).
baselines: Classical: MMSE, CHEMP, sphere decoding, K-best SD. Learned: DetNet, FS-Net, DLNet, OAMP-Net, CG network, DL-aided Tabu search (p. 10, p. 13).
metrics: BER versus SNR; operation counts (additions and multiplications); runtime of the eigen-RNN versus MMSE matrix inversion (p. 9, p. 11-12, p. 14).
complexity: Operation counts in closed form (Eq. 29, p. 12), operations versus SNR (Fig. 16, p. 14), and measured runtime of eigen-RNN versus MMSE inversion (Fig. 11, p. 13).
openness: none; implemented in Python with TensorFlow, no code or data link (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 3: "over a flat Rayleigh fading channel to the base station"; i.i.d. CN(0,1) entries from a custom simulator, no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured channel (also p. 9).
q2_support: p. 10: "Fifty percent of the dataset is utilized" for training and the other half for testing, same Rayleigh data; p. 14: "three different error variance" scenarios is a CSI-error sweep. No new scenario, band, or antenna count is tested.
q3_support: p. 10: "the DetNet [26], the FS-Net [30] are conducted for comparisons"; p. 13: "Additionally, we employ SD [16]" and "perform simulations involving the DetNet [26], the DLNet [28],". BER curves in Figs. 8, 9, 12, 13; MMSE, CHEMP, SD, K-best are non-learned.
q4_support: p. 11: "complexity are defined as the number of the operations, which" are additions and multiplications; Eq. (29) on p. 12 gives the DeepEigNet count; p. 12: "we measure the runtime" of the eigen-RNN.
q5_support: p. 10: "set of data samples is constructed by 100 channel realizations", an own simulated dataset; no code or data link in the paper, only Python and TensorFlow are named.
notes: Included, area 1: DeepEigNet (eigen-based RNN plus trained L-layer network, Algorithm 2, p. 6) gives initial symbol estimates to a probabilistic Tabu search; main metric is BER. The eigen-RNN solves eigen-pairs per matrix and the Tabu search is not learned. The CSI-error test on p. 14 is a sweep, so q2 is 0. MMSE-P-TS (p. 13) is an ablation, not counted as a baseline.
